comments.weights: Tunable by Policy Team (Person 5). Must sum to 1.0. Adjust based on business risk tolerance.
comments.thresholds: Risk level boundaries. LOW < 0.3 → no action, 0.3-0.7 MEDIUM → rate-limit, ≥0.7 HIGH → isolate+honeypot
comments.normalization_limits: Baseline maximums for normalizing sub-signals. Update based on your environment's attack baseline.
